about_the_game:
"Dies irae, dies illa

Solvet saeclum in favilla…"

"He sees himself at a witches' sabbath, among monsters, sorcerers, and the dead…"

The world is dying. The hard part is living through it.

Character Customization – Create your survivor and immerse yourself in a story that is truly your own.

Open-World Exploration – Enter homes, stores, police stations, and many other buildings. Every place with its own story, its own secrets.

Explore, Fight & Survive – Scavenge supplies, manage your inventory, and fight the infected with melee and ranged combat: blunt and bladed melee weapons, Pistols and Assault Rifles. Go out alone, or with your group members.

Simple Crafting – Scavenge, combine, survive.

Story-Driven Gameplay – Immerse yourself in the world, explore personal stories, interact with a charming cast and shape how your group sees you. Who will survive?

content_descriptors.notes: Song Of The Dead is a mature game with mature themes and potentially disturbing visuals. It is not recommended to those under the age of 18.

short_description: SONG OF THE DEAD is a hybrid open-world third-person survival horror experience with Visual Novel storytelling. Half exploration, half immersion in a deep character-driven narrative. Brutal combat, limited bullets, and impossible choices wrapped in a gritty anime aesthetic.
